author: BaconKingz
body:
Hi my in game username is BaconKingz and i would like to request an unban from your server.


I was banned for hacking (No knock-back) and this was severely unjust as i was not using hacks at all and was just playing normally. I was lagging really badly and that was why people thought i was hacking but i really didn't do anything on purpose.


I love this server and i would never do anything to wreck the experience so please unban me because i didn't do anything that was against the rules of the server!

Thanks.
